description: A PHP class named MAX_FileScanner used for reading and filtering files in directories based on criteria such as file extension and regex patterns. It supports recursive directory traversal and manages internal lists of files.

classes.name: MAX_FileScanner
classes.description: Class for scanning directories and filtering files based on masks and types, with support for recursive traversal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the scanner and resets internal state.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the internal list of files and last match data.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Adds a specific file to the internal list if it matches allowed criteria.

methods.name: addDir
methods.description: Reads a directory and adds all files, optionally recursively.

methods.name: _addRecursiveDir
methods.description: Recursively reads directories and adds files.

methods.name: getAllFiles
methods.description: Returns the list of collected files, sorted.

methods.name: setFileMask
methods.description: Sets a regex pattern to filter files.

methods.name: addFileTypes
methods.description: Adds allowed file extensions to filter files.

methods.name: isAllowedFile
methods.description: Checks if a file matches the extension and regex criteria.

methods.name: getFileExtension
methods.description: Returns the extension of a filename.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename from a path.

methods.name: buildKey
methods.description: Builds a key based on regex matches from filename.
